disturbances.name: Dispatcher shift: four corridor train delays
disturbances.description: An authored demonstration on the unchanged 16-service corridor with intermediate calls. Two early delays affect separate parts of the corridor; two later delays keep the shift active. Fixed simulation steps and train handles make the disturbance condition reproducible. This is a demonstration condition, not evidence of dispatcher performance.
